description: Share one thread with someone who has no BB account: they follow it live in a browser and suggest prompts that you approve. Guests see your messages and the agent's replies as they happen, with tool work shown only as counts such as "Ran 3 commands, edited 2 files". Each suggestion waits in a card above your composer, where you choose Use, Copy or Dismiss, so nothing a guest writes reaches the agent until you send it. The card also shows who is connected, kicks a guest, ends the link, and sets how long it lasts (4 hours by default). The link is a free Cloudflare quick tunnel, so the thread's text passes through Cloudflare and anyone with the link can watch; it needs the separate cloudflared program (on Linux the plugin can download a pinned, checksummed copy when you ask), and it requires BB 0.48 or later.
